title: Dualizing unit and composite tensor identifications
statement:
Fix the field $k$ and finite coefficient ring $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ ($n\ge1$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$) of [def-pur-conventions]. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes, with no absolute separatedness assumption, and all morphisms are separated and finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work on $D^b_{ctf}$ on the small pro-etale sites, with pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and the specified compactification projection, counit and tensor transpose $\theta_{a,K}$ [def-exchange-projection, def-pur-co-smoothness]. Put $W_a=Ra^!A$ and let $c_{b,a}:R(ba)^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra^!Rb^!$ be the conjugate of the compact-support compositor [thm-sf-comp-composition, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. For any composable $a:X\to Y$, $b:Y\to Z$, define
$$\sigma_{a,b}=c_{b,a,A}^{-1}\circ\theta_{a,W_b}\circ\mathrm{sym}:W_a\otimes^LLa^*W_b\longrightarrow W_{ba}.$$

For every $a$, $\theta_{a,A}$ is the canonical map $La^*A\otimes^LW_a\cong W_a$, with the coefficient-unit pullback comparison inserted. If $b$ has any isomorphism $\eta:W_b\xrightarrow{\sim}A_Y$, set
$$t_{a,\eta}=\operatorname{unitor}\circ(1_{W_a}\otimes La^*\eta):W_a\otimes^LLa^*W_b\xrightarrow{\sim}W_a.$$
Then $\sigma_{a,b}$ is invertible and its inverse, after this specified identification of its source with $W_a$, is
$$t_{a,\eta}\circ\sigma_{a,b}^{-1}=Ra^!(\eta)\circ c_{b,a,A}:W_{ba}\longrightarrow W_a.$$
In addition suppose a morphism $e:U\to X$ has a natural isomorphism $\rho_e:Re^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Le^*$, put $\eta_e=\rho_{e,A}$ with the coefficient-unit comparison, and assume
$$\rho_{e,K}\theta_{e,K}=\operatorname{unitor}(1\otimes\eta_e)$$
for every $K$ in the stated category. For every composable $h:X\to S$, put $E_{e,h}=\rho_{e,W_h}c_{h,e,A}$. Then
$$E_{e,h}\sigma_{e,h}=\operatorname{unitor}(\eta_e\otimes1):W_e\otimes^LLe^*W_h\longrightarrow Le^*W_h,$$
and $\sigma_{e,h}$ is invertible. All these formulas are natural under compatible restriction of the given operation, tensor, counit and composition data to open subschemes. No smoothness, orientation or Tate twist is required.

This is private tensor_unit, specialized to the fixed finite modules in dualizingTensor_unit. The unit comparison and the right unitor are the existing ones, unchanged.

The hypothesis is precisely naturality of projectionMap in its second variable. Postcompose by the exceptional image of the left unitor and use leftUnitor_naturality and preservation of composition. This is private tensor_naturality. No abstract symmetric tensor transport theorem or extra monoidal structure is needed.

proof.text: For any eta, apply the naturality equality from Step 2 at eta.hom and insert the unit equality from Step 1. Expand sigma and cancel the inverse of the specified exceptional conjugate against its hom. Functoriality of tensor and pullback gives exactly sigma followed by c.hom followed by a!(eta.hom) equals t.hom. The conjugate and t are the isomorphisms already constructed by def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition and the stated formula definitions. Hence sigma is invertible by IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right. Take asIso sigma, precompose the equality by its inverse, and cancel to obtain the required inverse formula.

proof.text: For source cancellation put K equal to the existing dualizingCompositeModel of h, whose property follows by constructibleFiniteTor_dualizingComplex applied to the coefficient unit. Apply the assumed rho normalization at K. Expanding sigma and cancelling c.inv followed by c.hom gives exactly the required equation. Its right side is invertible because tensor sends the iso dualizingRhoUnit to an iso and the left unitor is invertible. Since c.hom and rho.hom.app K are invertible, IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right proves that sigma is invertible.
